# Settings explanations

Status: **Partly built** · Section: Navigation, search, and commands · [All features](README.md)

## What is there

main.ts `sw()` rows show a note per switch and a line saying whether the value is the built-in choice or the person's own change, naming the built-in one (`SWITCH_PREF`, `fromLine`, rewritten when the switch changes); tests/settings-source.test.ts (hand-written list of all 16 switches)

## What is missing

progressive disclosure; the same line for sliders, time fields, language and colour; notes for sliders/time fields
